subject: Cannot fix negative eigenvalue in Hessian warnings

messages.author: 0d2fc6f6822cf81a
messages.subject: Cannot fix negative eigenvalue in Hessian warnings
parts:
Hello INLA users!

I have seen that Hessian warnings ( e.g., *** WARNING *** Eigenvalue 1 of the Hessian is -1838.47 < 0) were already discussed here. I checked the discussions and tried to use the advises, without success though. So, please let me repeat this topic again.

Details
I try to run a spatial-temporal mixed model for aerial data in INLA. I have 59 Norwegian municipalities, for which I model fisheries catches as a function of several covariates, and a municipality is my aerial unit. Then I include year as RW2 model and the spatial component as BYM. I believe there might be spatial-temporal interaction, so I need to check all 4 types of interactions between spatial and temporal components.

Importantly, fisheries data was highly skewed, so i log-transformed for the model. I tried also untransformed fisheries data as a response, but got zeroes for all the hyperparameters and huge DIC values. 

A model without interaction and an interaction type 1 both worked well, no warnings.
However, a model with interaction type 3 (between spatial u_i and temporal iid phi_i) crashes with a Hessian warning 
*** WARNING *** Eigenvalue 1 of the Hessian is -1838.47 < 0

M8$mode$mode.status is 1002, which I heard is bad. 

In the model summary, i can see that due to problems with Hessian, spatial u_i and temporal iid phi_i were not computed (Inf both).  

What I tried:
1) to reduce tolerance
2) to set restart=3
3) to change the value of Hessian to h=0.01 (helped for other models)
4) to change the default spatial hyperparameter priors to PC priors 

Code details:
PC priors
HyperBYM <- list(
  prec.unstruct = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)), 
  prec.spatial  = list(prior = "pc.prec", param = c(1, 0.01)))

Model formula and inla run:
form8 <-  fish_log ~ sea_area + wageco + popgrowth + unemployed +
  f(ID,
    model = "bym",
    graph = seafood.sel.path,
    adjust.for.con.comp = FALSE,
    scale.model = TRUE
    constr = TRUE) +
  f(year1,
    model="rw2") +
  f(year2,
    model = "iid") +
  f(ID_1, model = "iid",
    group = year1,
    control.group = list(model = "rw2")))


M8 <-inla(formula = form8,
          family = "gaussian",
          data=seafood_prep3,
    control.compute = list(dic = TRUE,
                           waic = TRUE),
    control.inla=list(int.strategy="eb", 
                      strategy="gaussian", 
                      tolerance = 0.000001,
                      restart=3,
                      h = 0.01))

If anyone has managed to solve that before?
I would appreciate any comments from Håvard, Finn and all INLA developers .

Marina
